question.text: Equation of travelling wave on a stretched string of linear density $5 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{m}$ is $\mathrm{y}=0.03 \sin (450 \mathrm{t}-9 \mathrm{x})$ where distance and time are measured in SI units. The tension in the string is:

solution.text:
We have given, $y=0.03 \sin (450 t-9 x)$

Comparing it with standard equation of wave, we get $\omega=$

$450 \mathrm{k}=9$

$\therefore \mathrm{v}=\frac{\omega}{\mathrm{k}}=\frac{450}{9}=50 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$

Velocity of travelling wave on a stretched string is given by $\mathrm{v}=\sqrt{\frac{\mathrm{T}}{\mu}} \Rightarrow \frac{\mathrm{T}}{\mu}=2500$

$\mu=$ linear mass density $\Rightarrow \mathrm{T}=2500 \times 5 \times 10^{-3}$

$\Rightarrow 12.5 \mathrm{~N}$
